title: Robert Service Campground

services.name: Campsite
services.desc: From Robert Service Campground, you can reach downtown Whitehorse via a 2.5 km walk or bike on the paved Millennium Trail, which follows the beautiful Yukon River. There’s a bus stop at the entrance of the campground, and a Route 302 bus will take you right downtown. Or take 3 minutes to zip into town with your own vehicle on Robert Service Way. Our facilities and amenities include coin-operated hot showers, clean bathrooms, potable water, fire pits and firewood for purchase, lockers, a small concession and have friendly Parks staff on-site daily from 7 a.m. to 11 p.m. Each group site is 20 x 35 feet and intended to accommodate large groups (maximum of 25 people) who are camping together.

services.name: Living with wildlife
services.desc: Whitehorse is the Wilderness City. We are surrounded by wildlife even in our own neighbourhoods, which means we all have a duty to manage our waste responsibly. Under the City’s Waste Management Bylaw, no person shall set out waste in any manner or condition that harbours or attracts wildlife. Properly managing your waste and other wildlife attractants is necessary to keep people and animals safe. Illegal dumping costs us all! We’ve all seen it: garbage, old appliances, broken TVs, mattresses, and other waste items dumped in the bush.
